en.name: Line Drawing Logo Animation
en.title: Line Drawing Logo Animation: Example and Code Recipe
en.description: A macro camera follows a plotter pen over textured paper as it draws a ring mark and letters, then the logo blurs and the date types on. Free recipe.
howto: Build one paper plane (1 unit = 2.8px, x-height 100 units) that holds the whole logo as stroke paths, and draw it with stroke-dashoffset on pathLength=10000 paths (GSAP rounds CSS lengths to whole numbers, so a pathLength of 1 would make every stroke jump). A thin pen (about 2px) draws the ring from 55% to 79% in take 1 (0–1.9s), then the blue meridian ellipse takes 0.9s at 2.3s. Light gray guides (36 strokes plus baseline ticks every 6 units) sit under the pen.

Run the camera as four takes with hard cuts at 1.9s, 3.4s and 4.7s: zoom 5.2→4.4 at 58° tilt, zoom 2.5→2.2 at 50°, zoom 1.9→1.75 at 55°, then zoom 1.15→0.78 at 52°→46° with power3.out, pulling back and sliding right so the 6 ends about 280px inside the frame. Keep the pen tip near the middle of the frame: aim the camera 4° of arc ahead of the tip in take 1, and about 25 units left of the letter being drawn in take 3. The 10 letter skeletons start from 3.0s, 0.16–0.22s apart. Fake depth of field with four copies of the plane blurred 0, 2.4, 6 and 12px under screen-space masks. The heavy pen (16 units, about 45px) fills the letters from 4.66s, 0.075s apart, with the strokes inside a letter drawn one after another.

At 5.8s cut to the flat logo, 1480px wide, hold it sharp to 7.0s, then defocus it over 0.9s (blur 0→16px, opacity 1→0.18, moving up 90px). Once the defocus is done, type the date below it from 7.75s (0.035s per character, expo.out) and the URL from 8.15s, and hold both to 11s. The paper and guides are on screen from frame 0. Press the copy button to send this recipe to Claude Code or Codex, or install the skill once with npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard, then render an MP4 with HyperFrames.
faq: How do you make a line drawing logo animation?

Put the logo's strokes on a path, give each path a large pathLength such as 10000 and animate stroke-dashoffset from 10000 to 0 so the line grows from its start. Draw a thin skeleton first and trace a heavy stroke over it afterwards, as this film does, so the logo seems to be drawn and then inked.
How does the film fake depth of field on a drawing?

It stacks four copies of the paper plane, blurs them 0, 2.4, 6 and 12px and masks each with a soft band, so the area around the pen stays sharp while the near and far paper blur. The band is set once per take and resets at each cut, with a half-width of 150, 190, 160 and 330px.

zh.name: 线条绘制 logo 动画
zh.title: 线条绘制 logo 动画：示例与代码配方
zh.description: 微距镜头跟着绘图笔在纸面上画出圆环标志和字母，随后标志虚化，日期和网址逐字打出。用 Claude Code 或 Codex 按免费配方做出这个效果。
howto: 用一张纸面平面（1 单位 = 2.8px，x 高度 100 单位）装下整个标志的笔画路径，每条路径设 pathLength=10000，用 stroke-dashoffset 画出（GSAP 会把 CSS 长度取整，pathLength 设成 1 时笔画会直接跳出来）。镜头一（0–1.9s）细笔（约 2px）把圆环从 55% 画到 79%，2.3s 起蓝色经线椭圆用 0.9s 画完。纸上有浅灰辅助线（36 条，另有每 6 单位一个的基线刻度）。

镜头分四个机位，在 1.9s、3.4s、4.7s 硬切：缩放 5.2→4.4、倾角 58°；缩放 2.5→2.2、倾角 50°；缩放 1.9→1.75、倾角 55°；最后缩放 1.15→0.78、倾角 52°→46°，用 power3.out，镜头向右拉远，让 6 的右边缘离画面右边约 280px。笔尖保持在画面中部：镜头一把镜头对准笔尖前方 4° 弧度，镜头三把镜头对准正在画的字母左侧约 25 单位。10 个字母骨架从 3.0s 起，每隔 0.16–0.22s 起笔。景深用四份同样的纸面平面，模糊 0、2.4、6、12px，再用屏幕空间蒙版叠起来。粗笔（16 单位，约 45px）从 4.66s 起每隔 0.075s 描实一个字母，字母内的笔画依次画出。

5.8s 硬切到正面标志，宽 1480px，清晰停到 7.0s，再用 0.9s 虚化（模糊 0→16px，不透明度 1→0.18，同时上移 90px）。虚化结束后，日期从 7.75s 起在标志下方逐字打出（每字间隔 0.035s，expo.out），网址从 8.15s 起，两者都停到 11s。纸面和辅助线从第 0 帧起就在画面上。点击复制按钮，把配方发给 Claude Code 或 Codex，也可以用 npx skills add krisyangdev/motionboard 安装 skill，再用 HyperFrames 渲染成 MP4。
faq: 线条绘制 logo 动画怎么做？
把 logo 的笔画写成路径，每条路径设一个较大的 pathLength（比如 10000），再把 stroke-dashoffset 从 10000 动画到 0，线条就从起点长出来。像这支片子一样先画细骨架、再用粗线描一遍，观众会先看到画线，再看到上墨。
这支片子怎么给线稿做景深？
把纸面平面叠成四份，分别模糊 0、2.4、6、12px，再各用一条柔和的蒙版带，笔尖附近保持清晰，近处和远处的纸面变模糊。蒙版带每个机位设置一次，在每次硬切时重设，半宽依次是 150、190、160、330px。
